work.description: Brief on the S. Anna congregation of the Padana natives in Naples (numeral read GI. by the OCR, between C/CI and CII) raises it to an archconfraternity with power of aggregation; LF19528 → LF19531 column change; complete 28 June 1836 closing (the dating line LF19563 contains a literal OCR mark |). Page-132 running title LF19464 and own provenance LF19611 excluded. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF19483–19483; the source closing at LF19561–19564 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima octava iunii Mmillesimo octingentesimo trigesimo sexto, | pontificatus Nostri anno sexto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
